ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 75-80% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing margins, distal tips, and the central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs cover the central and proximal areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black banding is observed along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. A dark vertical pigmentation wedge is located at the median notch. Scattered tan/brown focal spots are distributed across the white central surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 85 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 10% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 units, creating a jagged boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch and tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast tan and off-white pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) are densely concentrated on both distal tips. Sparse, small circular tan spots are distributed across the medial white surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark linear streak is visible on the inner-left lobe. A high-contrast set of intersecting dark linear markings (rake marks) is located on the outer-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on both distal fluke tips and prominent dark linear scarring on the dorsal-right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian subject (bird) in the background plane, visible between the two fluke lobes above the median notch.
